{{Quote|The people of this sector have no particular love for the Empire. If given the chance they may choose to become your allies, as have the Stomma and Quesoth.''"<br />"''Allies? You have allies, Thrawn. All to me except the Chosen are mere tools. They can be useful tools, or they can be broken tools.|Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Warlord Nuso Esva|<ref name="Choices" />}}
The '''Chosen''' were a group of [[Storm-hair]] [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] that served their master, Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]], with fanatical zeal since they emerged from an [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|unidentified]] [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] [[Planet/Legends|world]]. Esva's warriors, under their master's [[Commanding officer/Legends|lead]], [[Nuso Esva's conquests|destroyed]] dozens of worlds, peoples, and governments until around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] struck back.

In that [[Standard year/Legends|year]], the Storm-hair warlord sent a [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] of more than thirty Chosen to the [[Outer Rim Territories]] [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector]], where Chosen member [[Ranquiv]] directed an [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|operation]] to [[Death/Legends|murder]] Candoras' [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bidor Ferrouz]]. Attacking Ferrouz while Esva brought the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] to Candoras' [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]] would, according to the warlord, draw Thrawn to the Poln system, where Esva's [[Eastern Fleet]] would destroy him. Ranquiv's forces divided, with thirty going to [[Poln Minor]] and the rest to [[Poln Major]]. On Poln Minor, the Chosen armed fifty [[Whisperlike fighter]] with [[Caldorf VII interceptor missile|heavy weaponry]] while on Poln Major, they attacked Ferrouz along with several [[Gangster/Legends|thugs]]. However, the Rebel [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Hand of Judgment]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] group, Thrawn's [[Troukree]] agents, and [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] fended off the Chosen's attacks and located where they were holding Ferrouz's family. There, Skywalker and Jade killed the Chosen and freed the hostages while Thrawn's forces and the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]] [[Battle of the Poln system|defeated]] Esva's Eastern Fleet and Ranquiv's [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Esva and the Chosen retreated, but they continued their rampage across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], thirty Chosen and Esva traveled to the Unknown Regions planet [[Quethold]], where the [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] Quesoth people assisted the warlord in, once again, drawing Thrawn to his defeat. The [[Quesoth Soldier]]s and the Storm-hairs attacked the invading ground forces, but when Thrawn gave a command in [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] to the Quesoth, Esva killed the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|Quesoth ruler]], prompting the Quesoth Soldiers to kill him while Thrawn's [[Empire of the Hand]] stormtroopers took care of the remaining Chosen.

==Description==
{{Quote|Another fifteen hundred at least. Looks like a few of Nuso Esva's personal troops are in there with them.|A member of the Empire of the Hand, during the Empire's battle on Quethold against the Chosen.|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
Fanatical members of the [[Storm-hair]] [[Species/Legends|species]], the [[Special forces/Legends|elite]] [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] of the Chosen followed their [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]], Storm-hair [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] with fanatical zeal.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] and [[Sniper rifle/Legends|sniper rifles]],<ref name="Choices" /> the Chosen were known for their devastating attacks in the name of Esva and [[Gender/Legends|his]] [[Nuso Esva's realm|realm]], which if ended in a retreat, prompted the Storm-hairs to destroy everything they could not capture or conquer as they fell back.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> Several Chosen<ref name="Choices" /> were equipped with [[Armor/Legends|armor]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> [[Scout/Legends|Scouts]] of the Chosen wore corpses to protect themselves while sharing the location of their enemies.<ref name="Choices" />

==History==
===Emergence===
{{Quote|The Rebellion is a threat, but hardly the most serious one facing the Empire. Warlord Nuso Esva has become one of those threats. He possesses an unusually strong spacegoing navy, along with many slave and tributary worlds stretching into Wild Space and to the edge of the Empire. I believe he is even now planning to extend his influence into Imperial space.|Senior Captain Mitth'raw'nuruodo introduces Warlord Nuso Esva to [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Along with their master, the Chosen emerged from an [[Unidentified planet (Nuso Esva)|unidentified world]] in the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] and began their [[Death/Legends|lethal]] [[Nuso Esva's conquests|rampage]]<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] Unknown Regions and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]].<ref name="Choices" /> By [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="VsDate">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' are dated to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] by ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''. As the [[Empire of the Hand]] was fighting [[Nuso Esva]] during the novel's events, the conflict between the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] and the Empire must have began by 0 ABY.</ref> the Chosen and Esva came into conflict with the [[Empire of the Hand]], the shadow empire of [[Captain of the Line/Legends|Senior Captain]]<ref name="Choices" /> [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn,"<ref name="OBF">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref> of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Choices" />

===Blue eyes, yellow eyes===
====Kidnapping and Poln Minor====
{{Quote|From what I saw in the ship's after-action reports, the only reason Nuso Esva wanted to kill Ferrouz was to get you over to the Poln system so he could spring his trap. But the palace went ahead and issued the directive anyway.|Daric LaRone|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Thrawn-Hasbro.png|thumb|right|300px|Senior Captain Thrawn was Warlord Nuso Esva's biggest enemy.]]
To defeat Thrawn and begin invading the Galactic Empire, Esva and his commanders devised an [[Nuso Esva's campaign against the Galactic Empire|operation]] that would take place in the Imperial [[Candoras sector/Legends|Candoras sector's]] [[Poln system/Legends|Poln system]]. The Chosen would kidnap the [[Bidor Ferrouz's family|family]] of Candoras' [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Bidor Ferrouz]], and their master would command the governor to ally himself with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which would draw the senior captain to the [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Choices" /> In 0 ABY,<ref name="ChoicesDate">The events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' take place in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]].</ref> the Chosen kidnapped Ferrouz's [[Bidor Ferrouz's wife|wife]] and [[Ferrouz's daughter|daughter]] and Esva sent him a note listing his demands, including his alliance with the Rebellion, which included giving them a base on the Poln system's [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Poln Minor]]. If his demands were not satisfied, the warlord's elite warriors would kill the governor's family where they were holding them, a [[Cave/Legends|cave]] underneath Candoras' [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Poln Major]]'s surface. Additionally, Esva himself infiltrated the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']], aboard which he would travel to the Unknown Regions and bring Thrawn's [[Task Force Admonitor]] to Poln, where the Storm-hair's [[Eastern Fleet]] would destroy it. Additionally, Chosen leader [[Ranquiv]] and his Storm-hairs began arming [[Whisperlike fighter]]s that would assist in Thrawn's destruction.<ref name="Choices" />

With [[Treason/Legends|traitorous]] Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Pakrie]]'s insight, the Chosen learnt of most entrances and safe rooms in Ferrouz's [[Bidor Ferrouz's palace|palace]] in Poln Major's [[Whitestone City]], which they could infiltrate to kill Ferrouz at any point. On Poln Minor, the Rebels [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] were offered a job to mount Caldorf missiles on the Whisperlikes, which the pair accepted. Several Chosen and Ranquiv accompanied a group of nearly thirty workers to the cavern where the Storm-hairs were keeping their fighters. While the Rebels worked, Ranquiv, the thug known as [[Spikes]] and at least two Chosen discussed their coming attacks on Ferrouz. To the Chosen commander's anger, Solo and Organa [[Thief/Legends|stole]] a Whisperlike&mdash;which they lost before fleeing in a [[Speeder bus/Legends|speederbus]]&mdash;although Ranquiv and his Chosen bodyguards attempted to prevent it.<ref name="Choices" />

Shortly after Esva's ally, the Rebel [[Vestin Axlon]], and [[Emperor's Hand]] [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] met with Ferrouz in his [[Bidor Ferrouz's office|office]], the Storm-hair warriors and their thug allies attacked, blowing up the office's area and launching a ferocious [[Battle for Poln Major|siege]] of blastefire. While Esva's agents attempted to kill Ferrouz, Jade and Axlon were rescued by [[Daric LaRone]] and [[Saberan Marcross]], Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] part of the [[Hand of Judgment]] group. The group&mdash;excluding Jade, who killed two teams of Chosen in the palace's guard foyer&mdash;was able to fall back to a safe are of the palace grounds, whose basement led them to the [[Whistling Wind]] [[Tapcafe/Legends|tapcafe's]]. Not much later, the Chosen discovered their targets' location, and attacked to no avail, as the Hand of Judgment stormtroopers were able to repel the Storm-hairs' attack.<ref name="Choices" />

====Magenta blade and yellow eyes====
{{Quote|Three weeks ago my wife and daughter disappeared after returning from a shopping trip. The kidnappers sent me a holo of them in binders, along with a list of instructions. This deal with the Rebellion was one of them. The note was sent by someone calling himself Warlord Nuso Esva. But who he is&mdash;or whether he exists at all&mdash;I haven't been able to discover.|Governor Bidor Ferrouz|<ref name="Choices" />}}
[[File:Choices_of_One.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Chosen (bottom left and right) fight Emperor's Hand Mara Jade and Rebel Luke Skywalker during the battle for Poln Major.]]
Skywalker soon infiltrated the cavern where Ferrouz's family was being held hostage by hiding in Stelikag's landspeeder trunk. Jade did as well, watching several armed Chosen patrolling the area following a random guard pattern. Moments afterward, Ferrouz shared his location with Pakrie so that many of the Chosen and thugs surrounding his family would leave and therefore allow the Emperor's Hand to have a better chance at defeating the remaining forces, and nearly twenty humans and Storm-hairs left to attack the Hand of Judgment. Using a Chosen's corpse, Jade set off a catwalk trap to distract the guards while she crawled to the governor's family's cell. Meanwhile, Skywalker alarmed a guard, prompting two of the thug's companion to rush to kill the hostages; however, although the Chosen tried to prevent it, Jade and the Rebel were able to repel the Storm-hair attack, saving the hostages.<ref name="Choices" />

However, the Chosen did not give up on their attack on Ferrouz in the tapcafe, instead mounting an [[E-Web heavy repeating blaster/Legends|E-Web heavy repeating blaster]]. The [[Troukree]] [[Refugee/Legends|refugees]] that had allied themselves with the stormtroopers then intervened, [[Death|sacrificing]] the life of one of of their [[Unidentified Troukree (sacrifice)|own]] to destroy the E-web. A third attack came, but was repelled easily by Hand of Judgment [[Sniper/Legends|sharpshooter]] [[Taxtro Grave]]. Soon after, Ranquiv's Whisperlikes attempted to intervene in the battle over Poln Major, but were destroyed by a [[Golan I Space Defense Platform/Legends|Golan I]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], the Imperial [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], and Thrawn's forces, as was Esva's fleet, whose leader fled.<ref name="Choices" />

===Quesoth and Storm-hairs===
{{Quote|Tell Thrawn that he may think he's won. But with my death, his own will not be far off. My followers are still out there, and they're more numerous than he can possibly imagine. No matter where he goes, no matter where he tries to hide, they will find him. You'll tell him that.|Warlord Nuso Esva, to bowlcarrier Trevik|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]],<ref name="TERCCoF">The events of ''[[Crisis of Faith]]'' take place in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''.</ref> Esva and thirty Chosen traveled to the Unknown Regions planet known as [[Quethold]]. Promising its ruler, the [[Queen of the Red (8 ABY)|ruling]] [[Queen of the Red]] of the Quesoth, eternal dominion over Quethold by killing the monarch that would succeed her, the [[Queen of the White]], Esva earned the [[Queen/Legends|Queen's]] loyalty and trust. With that, the Storm-hair warriors prepared for the upcoming attack carried out by now-[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] Thrawn's forces, setting up the Quesoth's primitive [[Cannon/Legends|cannons]] across Quethold's [[Red City]] and employing [[Planetary shield/Legends|umbrella shields]] to protect their forces as well as the [[City/Legends|City]]. Aboard Thrawn's ''Admonitor'', [[Stromma Council Liaison]] [[Nyama]], a traitorous member of the Empire of the Hand, did the Queen's bidding, and suggested that a Quesoth that opposed Esva could record his [[Painting/Legends|artwork]] in the Red City's [[Dwelling of Guests]] building.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

[[File:Aurek_7_FB.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Empire of the Hand stormtroopers (pictured) faced the Chosen.]]
A member of the Quesoth [[Midli]] caste and the Queen of the Red's own [[bowlcarrier]], [[Trevik]], did so. Unbeknownst to him, however, the Storm-hair warlord had made that happen by ordering the Queen to command a [[Unidentified Circling|Circling]], an advisor and [[Reproduction/Legends|breeder]] of hers, to task Trevik with recording the artwork that his [[Trevik's family|brother]], [[Jirvin]], would share with Thrawn. By sharing his chosen paintings with the Chiss, the Grand Admiral would devise his strategy according to the pieces, which would allow Esva and his people to gain the upper hand.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after, Thrawn's stormtrooper forces [[Attack on the Red City|attacked]], with the three thousand [[Quesoth Soldier]]s assisting the Chosen in capturing the Imperial [[juggernaut]]s that they would use to infiltrate the Queen of the White's [[White City]]. The Soldiers fought with primitive weaponry such as maces while the Storm-hairs fired blaster pistols, but were ultimately able to breach the juggernauts. Meanwhile, Thrawn's forces commandeered a [[Speaker/Legends|loudspeaker]] that was broadcasting the Queen of the Red's orders in [[Quesoth Soldier Speak]] to her Soldiers, commanding them to protect Esva in the Dwelling of Guests. The warlord thought they were coming to take his life, and killed the Quesoth ruler and tasked Trevik with delivering a message to Thrawn: while his death had come, Thrawn's would come soon too, as the remaining Chosen were far more numerous than the Grand Admiral imagined, and they would hunt him down. Esva was then killed by stormtroopers, as were the remaining Chosen.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

===Legacy===
{{Quote|Don't worry, Captain. Whatever followers Nuso Esva has left are few and scattered. Without his leadership, they'll slink back into the shadows where they belong. And I've also made arrangements to have a bodyguard accompany me when I return to the Empire. Whatever vengeance Nuso Esva had planned, or thought he had planned, it will never reach me.|Grand Admiral Mitth'raw'nuruodo, to Senior Captain Voss Parck|<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />}}
Although Thrawn believed the message the Quesoth bowlcarrier had delivered to be incorrect, he still assured a bodyguard&mdash;<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> the [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]] [[Rukh/Legends|Rukh]]&mdash;<ref name="TLC">''[[The Last Command]]''</ref> accompanied him at all times while he returned to the now-fragmented Empire to rebuild it.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" /> While the Noghri protected him from the Chosen and other threats, he proved to be his cause of death, killing the Chiss in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]].<ref name="TLC" />

==Leaders and members==
{{Quote|Ranquiv's heading this way. He's got two armed men with him.''"<br />"''On a scale of one to ten, how unhappy do they look?''"<br />"''Very. There are two more men and two more of Ranquiv's yellow-eyed friends coming in about ten meters behind them.|Leia Organa and Han Solo|<ref name="Choices" />}}
Warlord Nuso Esva led the entirety of the Chosen while Ranquiv led the squadron sent to Poln Minor. A [[Unidentified Chosen (Poln Major)|Chosen]] announced the third attack on the Hand of Judgment,<ref name="Choices" /> while [[Unidentified Chosen (Quethold)|another]] pledged his life to the Queen of the Red.<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Chosen first appeared in [[Timothy Zahn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]''.<ref name="Choices" />
